hero.caption: Seat of the Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development with the sculpture Large Two Forms from Henry Moore in Bonn. Formerly (until 1999) the building was used by the "Bundeskanzleramt" (Federal Chancellery). Afterwards the building was redeveloped before the Ministry moved to this building.
hero.alt: Seat of the Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development with the sculpture Large Two Forms from Henry Moore in Bonn. Formerly (until 1999) the building was used by the "Bundeskanzleramt" (Federal Chancellery). Afterwards the building was redeveloped before the Ministry moved to this building.

images.caption:
Bonn, Germany: Konrad Adenauer head (first chancellor of the Federal Republic of Germany from 1949 till 1963); memorial in front of the former Federal Chancellery, Bundeskanzlerplatz nearby Adenauer-Allee.
Description on separate sign :
Konrad Adenauer
born 1876
died 1967
The first Federal Chancellor of the Federal Republic of Germany 
from 1949 to 1963 who stamped the policy of this time
the reconciliation with France initiated 
and prepared for the European arrangement ways.
The monument plastic also points to life stations 
of the statesman with modeled pictogrammes and assigned annual figures, 
as for example Cologne Cathedral,
Prussian eagle, Federal Chancellor, cathedral of Reims, 
Siebengebirge, Europe on the bull.
sculptor: Hubertus von Pilgrim, Munich

installation: may 1982
